description: A vibe coding tool that generates React dashboards with Pucho branding, Pucho AI Studio workflow JSONs (schemaVersion 7), and auto-wired webhook connections between frontend and backend workflows.

userStories.title: Project scaffolding with Vite + React + Tailwind + Pucho brand system
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the base project scaffolded with Vite, React, Tailwind CSS, and the Pucho brand system configured so all subsequent stories build on a working foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: Vite + React + TypeScript project initialized in src/dashboard/
Tailwind CSS configured with Pucho brand colors as custom theme tokens (#5922c6, #af3db8, #ffffff, #000000, #fffac0, #91ffd0, #93d6ff)
Google Fonts loaded: Anek Latin (600-700), Lato (300-500), Chivo Mono (600-700)
Global CSS applies brand visual rules: 12px card radius, 8px button radius, 6px input radius, shadow 0 1px 3px rgba(89,34,198,0.08)
Pucho logo rendered in sidebar header from CDN URL
Sidebar uses bg #f8f5ff with gradient header linear-gradient(135deg, #5922c6, #af3db8)
Footer displays 'Powered by Pucho.ai'
npm run dev starts the dev server without errors
npm run build completes without errors
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Install and configure Recharts and TanStack libraries
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Recharts for charts and TanStack Table/Query for data handling so the dashboard can display data-driven visualizations.
acceptanceCriteria: Recharts installed and importable
TanStack Table (@tanstack/react-table) installed and importable
TanStack Query (@tanstack/react-query) installed with QueryClientProvider wrapping the app
A sample chart component renders using Pucho brand colors (Pucho Violet primary, Violet Blossom secondary, Sky Blue, Mint Green)
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create reusable Pucho UI component library
userStories.description: As a developer, I need reusable branded UI components so all dashboard pages have consistent Pucho styling.
acceptanceCriteria: PuchoCard component: white bg, 12px rounded corners, brand shadow, 16px padding, 24px gap between cards
PuchoButton component: primary (#5922c6), secondary (#af3db8), 8px rounded corners, hover states
PuchoKPI component: displays label (Lato), value (Chivo Mono 600-700 in Pucho Violet), optional trend indicator
PuchoTable component: wraps TanStack Table with Pucho styling (Black body text, Pucho Violet headers)
PuchoSidebar component: bg #f8f5ff, logo at top, nav items with active state (Violet text + left border)
Loading state shows 'Pucho is thinking...'
Empty state shows 'No data yet — your workflows will populate this'
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build KPI summary row with sample data
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see key metrics at a glance in a row of KPI cards at the top of the dashboard so I can quickly assess performance.
acceptanceCriteria: KPI row renders 4 PuchoKPI cards in a responsive grid
KPI values displayed in Chivo Mono font in Pucho Violet
KPI labels displayed in Lato font
Cards have proper spacing (24px gap) and brand shadows
Sample data: Total Workflows (42), Active Users (1,284), Success Rate (98.7%), Avg Response (1.2s)
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build interactive charts section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see workflow execution trends and distribution charts so I can analyze patterns over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Area chart showing 'Workflow Executions' over 7 days using Recharts
Pie/donut chart showing 'Workflow Distribution' by category
Charts use Pucho color sequence: Pucho Violet -> Violet Blossom -> Sky Blue -> Mint Green
Charts wrapped in PuchoCard components
Responsive layout: 2 charts side-by-side on desktop, stacked on mobile
Sample data hardcoded for demo purposes
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build data table with workflow execution logs
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a sortable and filterable table of recent workflow executions so I can drill into specific runs.
acceptanceCriteria: PuchoTable renders workflow execution logs with columns: Workflow, Status, Duration, Timestamp
Table supports sorting by clicking column headers
Status column shows colored badges (green=success, red=failed, yellow=running)
At least 10 sample rows of data
Table body text in Black (Lato), header text in Pucho Violet (Anek Latin)
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create Pucho workflow JSON generator utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a utility that generates valid Pucho AI Studio workflow JSON (schemaVersion 7) so the dashboard can create backend API endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: createWorkflow() function generates valid schemaVersion '7' JSON
Workflow JSON includes trigger with @puchoaistudio/tool-webhook pieceName and ~0.4.8 version
Supports chaining actions via nextAction pattern
Utility supports key tools: webhook, http, code, schedule, google-sheets, gmail, slack
Tool pieceName follows pattern: @puchoaistudio/tool-{name}
Generated JSON matches the schema provided in the PRD
TypeScript typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Schema: { name, template: { trigger: { type: 'PIECE_TRIGGER', settings: { pieceName, pieceVersion, triggerName }, nextAction }, schemaVersion: '7' } }

userStories.title: Build workflow template library with preset workflows
userStories.description: As a user, I want preset workflow templates so I can quickly deploy common automation patterns without building from scratch.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 3 preset workflow templates: 'Webhook to Google Sheets', 'Scheduled Email Report', 'Slack Notification on Webhook'
Each template generates valid schemaVersion 7 JSON using the createWorkflow utility
Templates displayed in a card grid in the UI with Pucho branding
Clicking a template shows the generated JSON in a code viewer
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create webhook connection manager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a webhook connection manager that auto-wires frontend dashboard data sources to Pucho workflow webhook triggers.
acceptanceCriteria: WebhookManager class/module that maps dashboard data endpoints to workflow webhook URLs
registerConnection(dashboardId, workflowWebhookUrl) stores the mapping
triggerWebhook(dashboardId, payload) sends data to the connected workflow
Connection status tracked: connected, disconnected, error
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build webhook connections UI panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want a UI panel showing all webhook connections between my dashboard and Pucho workflows so I can manage integrations visually.
acceptanceCriteria: Connections panel accessible from sidebar navigation
Each connection shows: dashboard source name, workflow name, status badge (green=connected, red=error, gray=disconnected)
Add Connection form with dashboard source and webhook URL fields
Connection cards use PuchoCard styling
Tagline 'Pucho Toh Sahi!' displayed in the panel header
TypeScript typecheck passes

userStories.title: Full integration test and polish
userStories.description: As a user, I want the complete dashboard to work end-to-end with all sections integrated, all brand rules applied, and all components connected.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard renders with sidebar navigation: Dashboard, Workflows, Connections
Dashboard page shows KPI row, charts section, and data table
Workflows page shows template library
Connections page shows webhook connections panel
All pages follow Pucho brand rules: colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
Loading states show 'Pucho is thinking...'
Empty states show 'No data yet — your workflows will populate this'
Footer shows 'Powered by Pucho.ai' on every page
npm run build completes without errors
TypeScript typecheck passes
